title: GitHub Actions Workflow Generator
description: Generate a CI workflow YAML — language presets, triggers, build and test steps.
howto: Name the workflow and pick a language preset.
Choose triggers (push, pull request) and branches.
Toggle tests and add extra run steps.
Copy the YAML or download ci.yml.

faqs.a: Node.js, Python, Go, Java (Maven), .NET and Rust — each with idiomatic setup, build and test steps.
One per line as "Step name: shell command".
Save it as .github/workflows/ci.yml in your repository.
Yes — standard workflow syntax using current action versions (checkout@v4, setup-*/v4/v5).
